Hamzah chapter_mode=current_unfinished means page.js substitutes the first unfinished chapter from the 58-unit sequence.
Hamzah's chapter advances only after completion, not by calendar date.
Full-length days override normal schedules for both students.
The day after each full length is reserved for deep review.
Overflow is tracked separately for Diya and Hamzah.
